title: Online BCA in Mobile Programming Course | DSU Online
description: Master Android, iOS, and cross-platform app development with DSU Online's Mobile Programming elective. Build, test, and publish real-world mobile apps today.

blocks.x: Android & iOS app development | UI/UX design | API integration | App testing & publishing

This elective teaches you how to develop interactive mobile applications for Android and iOS platforms using modern frameworks and deployment techniques. It is unique because: You will gain practical skills in Android/iOS app development, UI layout design, mobile API integration, app testing, and publishing. Role mappings include Mobile App Developer, Flutter/React-Native Developer, and App QA Engineer. Learners will be able to publish real apps, generate freelance income, and create startup-style prototypes, preparing them for real-world mobile development opportunities.
Develop interactive Android and iOS applications, implement responsive UI layouts, and integrate APIs for dynamic app functionality.
Build cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter or React Native frameworks, ensuring smooth performance and consistent UI/UX.
Test mobile apps, perform debugging, ensure performance optimization, and prepare applications for publishing on app stores.
Integrate mobile apps with cloud services, REST APIs, and databases to enable real-time and data-driven mobile experiences.
Publish real apps on Play Store or App Store, generate freelance income, and prototype startup-style apps for market-ready solutions.
